name: OB-GYN

pf.license.need: a state medical license for each OB-GYN doctor and nurse practitioner, and the practice's registration where the state's rules require it; a state or federal registration for any in-office procedure or ultrasound the state names; a home-visit license where the state requires one for care at the patient's home
pf.license.who: both: the practice, and each clinician who sees patients
pf.license.ask: optional, for the owner's own page: each clinician's license number, the practice's registration; nothing is needed to book
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up a license, certificate or training record; the owner keeps them current
pf.license.scope: a clinician sees only the kinds of care their license covers; a procedure or ultrasound is done only by a clinician the state names for it; Rosie never gives medical advice
pf.license.blocks: none from Rosie: no booking is held or refused because a license can't be read
pf.license.renewals: none kept by Rosie: the owner keeps the renewal dates
pf.license.insurance: the owner's own liability insurance; Rosie never verifies it
pf.license.background: the practice's own background checks for staff who go into a patient's home, where its rules or the state require them; Rosie never verifies them
pf.license.telehealth: a video visit counts as at the office; the clinician's license for the patient's state applies

pf.services.shape: OB-GYN office: a patient books a visit with a named doctor or nurse practitioner (or the next open clinician who takes new patients); a video visit counts as at the office; a home visit by a nurse practitioner for a postpartum check or a patient who can't easily leave home; no walk-in line; same-day sick visits are offered first
pf.services.examples: the example office's own prices and lengths, not a standard

pf.services.capacity: exam rooms at the office (example 4), each a 15-minute slot for a short visit or 45 minutes for a new patient; home visits by route, a set number each morning

pf.services.nobodyHome: never: the patient must be there
pf.services.walkIns: no walk-in line; same-day sick visits are offered first from the next open time

steps.when: on the secure page before the first visit
steps.result: done: booked; not done: the desk asks once, then the visit waits

steps.when: signed on the secure page before the visit
steps.result: signed: booked; not signed: the visit goes ahead without that exam

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: by the desk before the visit
steps.result: covered, part covered (the share shown), or not covered (self-pay); where the plan's rules require it, a notice of likely non-coverage is signed before the visit

steps.name: A teen's visit

pf.first_steps.prep: for the reminder: photo ID, the plan card, a list of medicines, and any old records; a urine or blood sample may be asked for at the visit; for a home visit, clear the path to the room

pf.visit.checkIn: at the front desk: the code, then photo ID and the plan card checked against the secure page; a chaperone is offered for any pelvic exam; a home visit: the code at the door, then photo ID
pf.visit.changes: the clinician adds a test, an ultrasound or an in-office procedure: priced first, with the self-pay price shown; a placement waits for a written OK; nothing else is sold at a visit
pf.visit.cantGoAhead: no ID, a pelvic exam with no consent, bleeding that is an emergency (911 words first), or the patient feels faint: the visit stops; a new visit is booked with no charge
pf.visit.done: the code, then DONE from the clinician; the bill is the practice's; results go to the patient's secure page or the patient portal; Rosie keeps only booking records
pf.visit.rejected: a lab sample that can't be used: the patient is offered a new draw with no charge, by the secure page
pf.visit.dropOff: none: the office takes no drop-offs; a sample is sent by the office's own lab

pf.money.before: new patient visits, checkups and procedures take nothing when booking; a self-pay video follow-up is paid in full when booking; a card may be saved for a no-show fee only if the owner turns it on
pf.money.insurance: health plans: only the plan's name before times; member details on the secure page; the practice bills the plan; the patient's share is billed after the plan pays (Rosie texts the bill); a notice of likely non-coverage is signed before the visit where the plan's rules require it
pf.money.thirdParty: none: an employer or family member is never the payer through Rosie
pf.money.estimate: a self-pay patient gets a written price estimate before a procedure, where the rules require it
pf.money.caps: deposit cap: from the state form
pf.money.fees: the owner's no-show fee (example $20), a card saved only when the owner turns it on, never for a fee-free patient; a home visit's visit fee is billed after, and only if agreed when booking
pf.money.refunds: the owner decides refunds; Rosie never refunds on its own

pf.messages.never: the diagnosis, a pregnancy, the names of tests or procedures, results, medicines, ID numbers and plan details never go in a text: only the secure page; texts say only the practice's name, the day, the time and the place
pf.messages.staffTexts: the owner and staff get the patient's initials, the time and the room; no health details
pf.messages.results: a text says only 'your results are ready on the secure page' or 'your doctor will call you'
pf.messages.minors: a teen's and a child's texts go to the parent or guardian, where the state's rules say so

pf.staff.licenses: each doctor and nurse practitioner holds a state license; the practice keeps its own record (optional, never looked up by Rosie)
pf.staff.skills: obstetrics, gynecology, prenatal and postpartum care, contraception and IUD placement, in-office ultrasound, chaperones, Spanish
pf.staff.supervision: the practice's medical director; a new clinician works under a senior one until signed off
pf.staff.oks: the owner OKs new patients, refunds and any procedure price
pf.staff.standIn: a patient may ask for a named clinician; if that clinician can't take it, the desk offers the next open day or another clinician with the skill; a pelvic exam is done only by a clinician with a chaperone's OK
pf.staff.away: only clinicians cleared for home visits go to a patient's home

pf.rules.privacy: a health privacy agreement (a business associate agreement) is signed before going live; health details only on the secure page
pf.rules.records: medical records are the practice's own, kept as long as the state's rules require; Rosie keeps only booking records
pf.rules.consent: a pelvic exam or procedure needs the patient's own consent on the secure page; a teen's consent follows the state's rules
pf.rules.showFacts: the practice's name and address; no license claim unless the owner gives it as the owner's own word
pf.rules.results: results go to the patient's secure page or portal within the time the health privacy rules set
pf.rules.reviews: a rating is never asked for health work (sensitive); any reply never confirms the person was a patient

pf.edges.noOrder: a referral the plan needs: the desk asks the plan while the patient waits, or the visit moves with no fee
pf.edges.rejected: a lab sample that can't be used: a free new draw
pf.edges.critical: a result that needs same-day care: the clinician calls the patient, never a text
pf.edges.faint: a patient feels faint at a visit: the visit stops, the patient lies down, 911 if hurt; the owner is told with no health detail
pf.edges.kids: a teen or child is seen with a parent or guardian, as the state's rules say
pf.edges.mobile: a homebound patient doesn't come to the door: the clinician calls, then the contact on the booking; the owner decides a welfare check; no fee while the patient's safety is unknown
pf.edges.results: results to the patient; never to the payer
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way

Pick a money choice at the top to follow its path.

Kit, a nurse practitioner, comes Thu Oct 22, arriving 8 to 10am, with a medical bag. The practice bills Alex's plan its own way. Pick a money choice at the top to follow its path.

notes: Built Oct 27 2026 on the R01-refitted primary-care (the sibling). Plug-in written for an OB-GYN office and its home visits (services, questions, safety words, first steps, visit rules, money, messages, staff, rules, edges); sensitive on for health; welfare on for the home visits. Money: A plan-billed visit (copay at the desk), a self-pay video follow-up paid in full, a no-show card; B home visit billed to the plan its own way, or the bill texted. $2: the $2 applies to every profession (D97): the 'No $2' branch is off, the 'Yes' branch stays. Licenses: never looked up or claimed checked by Rosie (D96); the lookup branches and lookup-only steps are off and the lit words say the owner's own word. Names: Dana and Mira (office), Kit and Rosa (home), Pat (office manager, kept). No pelvic exam at home; a newborn is seen with a parent there; a teen books alone only where the state's rules allow.
